page_purpose: This page provides an overview of the user's financial status and quick access to various modules within Zoho Books. It serves as a central hub for monitoring key financial metrics.
summary: The Home Dashboard in Zoho Books presents a consolidated view of the user's financial activities, including total receivables, total payables, and a cash flow analysis over a fiscal year. It also features promotional content for upcoming workshops and quick links to other application functionalities.
